message: the lambda performs Alloc, and the field `Same.eq` declares `effect(pure)`
label: performs Alloc
notes: a call through `Same.eq` is charged what the field declares and nothing else, so everything stored in it has to keep that
a lambda of two or more parameters allocates the closure for each argument but the last, so calling it performs `Alloc`; a field of two or more parameters declares `effect(alloc)` at least
help: store a function that keeps the declaration, or declare the effect on the field with `;@axiom:effect(alloc)`
